entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I was right to expect great things of you.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: This trial was exceptionally difficult,[n]but I had no doubt that you would[n]succeed.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Because of the power you have built[n]through your unyielding efforts...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You will surely be able to carve a path[n]to the future.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You have defeated he who averted[n]the fall of humanity... Most impressive.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You have come so far on your journey,[n]attaining a strength that rivals those[n]of past heroes...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: As the one tasked to guide you along[n]your path, there is no greater honor[n]than to witness such magnificence.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: As long as you bear such power, you[n]will assuredly carve a path to your[n]desired future.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You have defeated he who dispelled[n]an unyielding shroud of haze... Truly[n]remarkable.
